name: Sweep
author: RaptorSense
about: A soft column of light crossing the keyboard from left to right.

name: Pulse
author: RaptorSense
about: The whole keyboard slowly breathing between bright and dim.

name: Ripple
author: RaptorSense
about: A ring spreading out from the middle of the keyboard.

name: Waterfall

name: Rainbow drift
author: RaptorSense
about: A rainbow across the keyboard, sliding sideways.
